rules.rationale: Defining equation for the proof-local strCodes projection on a semantic string constructor.
Owise defining equation that completes the proof-local total strCodes projection on non-string Val constructors.
Base equation defining the allStrVS proof-domain predicate on the empty value sequence.
Structural recurrence defining allStrVS on a value-sequence head and its strictly smaller tail.

Guarded simplification of the pre-existing applyCmp operation, not an equation defining a new summary; Stage 1 compiles this rule before every proof and provides no exact proof against a module omitting it, so it is a trusted additional mathematical fact.
Base equation defining the filterAcc mathematical summary when no input elements remain.
Contained-element recurrence defining filterAcc by appending the string head and recursing on the tail; its simplification attribute does not change its definitional role.
Excluded-element recurrence defining filterAcc by retaining the accumulator and recursing on the tail; its simplification attribute does not change its definitional role.
